name: mirage
text: That detail helps a lot. Everything vanishing together for about 15 seconds fits one list-wide event, not each bet aging out separately. My fair-price-age theory is now less likely. The likelier cause is the whole list being swapped or emptied, either when the phone adopts a new list from GitHub or on its 15-second recheck. The log will now record these bulk drops with the list's age, whether a scan is running, and whether GitHub is driving. I'm finishing the build now and will tell you when it's out.
